/*
    Inclusion of CUST_CIF_NBR (CIF) -> This will be used to JOIN in CI_DEMOGRAPHIC
*/
SELECT
    TXN.*
    ,CCD.CUST_CIF_NBR AS FCBSCIF
/*
    Remove the duplicates using ROW_NUMBER() window function
*/
FROM (
SELECT
    *
    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TXN_ACCT_NBR, TXN_CARD_NBR, TXN_CODE, TXN_POSTING_DTE, TXN_AUTH_CODE, TXN_ACQ_REF, TXN_BATCH_SEQ
        ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) DESC) RN
    FROM eds.CCD_CBCEXCTDBP TXN
    --WHERE CAST(CAST(TXN_DTE AS char(8)) AS date) >= '2024-04-01'
) TXN
/*
    Link all customers associated to the account of the transaction using AAS
    Fetch the ORGKEY in CUSTOMER_DIM
*/
INNER JOIN
    (SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUST_CIF_NBR, CRDACCT_NBR, CARD_NBR FROM eds.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE, CUST_CIF_NBR, CRDACCT_NBR, CARD_NBR) CCD
    ON TXN.TXN_ACCT_NBR = CCD.CRDACCT_NBR
    AND TXN.TXN_CARD_NBR = CCD.CARD_NBR
    AND CAST(CAST(TXN_DTE AS char(8)) AS date) = CAST(CCD.AS_OF_DATE AS DATE)
WHERE RN = 1 AND CCD.CUST_CIF_NBR IS NOT NULL


/*
    Daily Authorization
    Inclusion of CUST_CIF_NBR (CIF) -> This will be used to JOIN in CI_DEMOGRAPHIC
*/
SELECT
    TXN.*
    ,CCD.CUST_CIF_NBR AS FCBSCIF
/*
    Remove the duplicates using ROW_NUMBER() window function
*/
FROM (
SELECT 
    *
    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RETR_KEY, MESSAGE_TYPE, TRAN_END_TIME, AUTH_NBR, CARD_NBR, INTERNAL_RESP_CODE, BANKNET_REF_NBR, RECV_ID
        ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) DESC) RN
    FROM eds.CCD_CBCEXTXLGP TXN --where CARD_ACCT_NBR = '7960f73896dccab84af5ca28a2379af1' and CARD_NBR = 'dcee98b3fbbbb0f94663c571483daeb7'
    --WHERE CAST(CAST(TRAN_DATE AS char(8)) AS date) >= '2024-04-01'
) TXN
/*
    Link all customers associated to the account of the transaction using AAS
    Fetch the ORGKEY in CUSTOMER_DIM
*/
INNER JOIN
    (SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUST_CIF_NBR, CRDACCT_NBR, CARD_NBR FROM eds.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT_CI_20240618-- WHERE AS_OF_DATE >= '2024-04-01' 
    GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE, CUST_CIF_NBR, CRDACCT_NBR, CARD_NBR) CCD
    ON TXN.CARD_ACCT_NBR = CCD.CRDACCT_NBR
    AND TXN.CARD_NBR = CCD.CARD_NBR
    AND CAST(CAST(TXN.TRAN_DATE AS char(8)) AS date) = CAST(CCD.AS_OF_DATE AS DATE)
WHERE RN = 1 AND CCD.CUST_CIF_NBR IS NOT NULL

SELECT TOP 10 SOLIDSET.SOL_ID,SOLIDSET.BANK_ID, max(AREA.SET_DESC) AREA, max(REGION.SET_DESC) REGION,max(DD.FULLDATE) SCD_START_DATE FROM EDS.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE SOLIDSET  
                LEFT JOIN EDS.vw_AREA_DIM AREA
                        ON SOLIDSET.SET_ID = AREA.SET_ID
                        AND SOLIDSET.BANK_ID = AREA.BANK_ID
                        AND SOLIDSET.SCD_START_DATE BETWEEN CASE WHEN ISDATE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,AREA.SCD_Start_date)) = 0 THEN CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(AREA.FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE) ELSE CAST(AREA.SCD_Start_date AS DATE) END and AREA.SCD_End_date
                LEFT JOIN EDS.vw_REGION_DIM REGION
                        ON SOLIDSET.SET_ID = REGION.SET_ID
                        AND SOLIDSET.BANK_ID = REGION.BANK_ID
                        AND SOLIDSET.SCD_START_DATE BETWEEN CASE WHEN ISDATE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,REGION.SCD_Start_date)) = 0 THEN CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(REGION.FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE) ELSE CAST(REGION.SCD_Start_date AS DATE) END   and REGION.SCD_End_date
                INNER JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM DD
                        ON DD.FULLDATE = COALESCE(SOLIDSET.SCD_START_DATE,AREA.SCD_Start_date,REGION.SCD_Start_date)
                WHERE SOLIDSET.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND SOLIDSET.DEL_FLG <> 'Y' AND (LEFT(SOLIDSET.SET_ID,2) = 'AR' OR LEFT(SOLIDSET.SET_ID,3) = 'REG')
                GROUP BY SOLIDSET.SOL_ID,SOLIDSET.BANK_ID

SELECT ISDATE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,SCD_Start_date)) FROM EDS.vw_AREA_DIM
